title: Desktop input box designs (large variant)
cardText: Desktop Input box designs  Large variant

componentSet.name: Copilot desktop Input Box
componentSet.note: Library set (remote); the plan's 5563:230560 is an instance of it. Variants: Type=Landing Page | Bottom small | Bottom large; State=Default | Limit exceed | Generating; Tools & Sources=Yes | No; Text=Placeholder | One line | Two line | Max line; Attachment=No | Yes; boolean Inline Skills.

measurements.landing: padding 10, rows 12 apart: field (2px top inset, 52 = two lines, grows to 314 = 12 lines) / action bar 32; radius 24; 116 tall empty; 640 wide on the landing page
measurements.bottomSmall: 760x48, padding 8/10, radius-full: + (32) | chips (2 x 32, icon only) | field (padding 0/6, 26 tall) | 12 | actions (104)
measurements.bottomLarge: padding 10 (8 on top above files), radius 24: field (26 per line, up to 312) / 12 / action bar 32 -> 90, 116, 142 … 376
measurements.attachments: Attachments Desktop row 58 = 6 + 48 + 4, items 12 apart from a 4px inset; image thumb 48 (radius 8), file card 300x48; remove button 20, overhang 6
measurements.shadow: the instances in these frames add a drop shadow 0 4 8 rgba(215,211,208,.30) (landing) / .25 (bottom); the Projects dashboard instance has none
measurements.dock: chat frames wrap the composer in a 760x76 frame with 28px bottom padding and a fade from bg-workspace (55.1%) to transparent (67.3%)
measurements.placeholder: _Text animate Desktop 5546:212948: prop=01 -> Break1 -> prop=02 -> Break2 -> prop=03 -> Break3 -> prop=04 -> Break4 -> prop=01; hold 4.5s, break 0.2s, smart animate 300ms ease-in-out. Hints: "Use /skill to give your agent a capability.", "Use @name to bring an agent or colleague here.", "Use + to connect the necessary apps.", "Describe the outcome — I will build the steps." (the master's prop=04 reads "Chat to search the enterprise database.")
measurements.tokens: skill token = "/" + name, 15/26, steel-blue-400 (the landing frames draw the "/" in utility-blue-dark-600 #155eef); mention = "@" + name in steel-blue-400

openQuestions: The landing frames color the skill "/" utility-blue-dark-600 and the chat frames steel-blue-400. Proposed: steel-blue-400 everywhere (fix composer-skill-slash-colour).

Frame 08 shows Stop under a finished answer, and 24 shows Stop while the answer is already written. Is the composer meant to stay in Generating until the suggested actions land? Proposed: Stop until the answer completes, then Voice/Send.

Limit pill: the pill reads -2346 and the tooltip 2343 characters. What is the limit (characters or tokens), and does the pill count down before the limit? Proposed: characters, pill only past the limit, both numbers from one count.
When the pill becomes Bottom large, should it shrink back to the pill once the text fits one line again? Proposed: yes (the prototype re-measures on every edit).
Landing Two line: the second line sits 22px under the first (two text nodes) while Max line uses 26. Proposed: 26 throughout.
The rotating placeholder: does it pause while the field has focus? Proposed: no, it keeps rotating while the field is empty.
